prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production artwork only, wide hero panel for the Storum pallet storage site.
Input image 1: strict art-direction and composition reference, NOT the output canvas. Recreate only the large architectural warehouse cross-section scene on its right, filling the entire new image. OMIT all webpage UI, text, markups and layout outside the scene.
Scene: orthographic straight-on cut through one industrial warehouse, like a premium architectural competition section. Thick graphite cut roof slab, deep graphite concrete foundation, precise vertical cut wall on far-left, steel pallet rack uprights, full two tiers of pale cool-gray crates on wooden Euro pallets, and a small side-view near-black forklift at the far right. Warm ivory paper outside the silhouette; understated stippled concrete and engraved technical linework inside. No real-world site or address implied.
Composition: landscape about 1.85:1; a single uninterrupted rectangular elevation almost wall-to-wall, roof entirely in view, section slab and floor along bottom. Key focal point one AND ONLY one cubical palletized load in ochre-gold on the upper rack level, horizontally just left of center (around 34% of the image), front view and clearly distinct from adjacent neutral crates. Architectural, not isometric: all uprights vertical, all beams level. One large angular golden shaft of sunlight from the top right crosses the room. Desaturated grey, zinc, ivory and charcoal except gold load and warm shaft.
Constraints: no text, letters, numbers, dimension labels, ruler lines, title, logo, border frame, controls, browser or design mockup. No invented signage. Keep the recognizable subject, rich material detail, razor-clean building section and framing of the reference. Artwork needs to work by itself, not a screenshot.
